articleTitle: Application of adaptive method of linear programming for technical objects control
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In works of R. Gabasov and his colleagues the adaptive method for solving the interval linear programming problems is proposed. This approach has wide applications in optimal control of dynamic objects. The implementation of this method for particular situations requires specific modifications of the basic algorithm. In this paper an algorithm for solving of an optimal control problem in real time for a technical object a type of multiple-input is offered.

articleTitle: The Hilbert-Huang Transform for biomedical signals processing
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The article reports of a new method of biomedical signals processing that makes it possible to analyze their structure in detail. The Hilbert-Huang Transform includes an algorithm of empirical mode decomposition designed for decomposing signals into a set of components with a subsequent analysis of its time and frequency distribution by the Hilbert transform.

articleTitle: Neural network model of wavelets for the continuous wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The existing methods of wavelet synthesis for CWT either do not provide an analytic representation of the wavelet function, or lead to a significant deviation of the synthesized wavelet from the original fragment. The proposed by the author neural network wavelet models allow to avoid both disadvantages. Synthesized wavelets correspond to the admissibility conditions and can be used both in the direct continuous wavelet transform and the reverse continuous wavelet transform. This is confirmed by the simulation test results in MATLAB.

articleTitle: OD-matrix estimation based on plate scanning
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of OD-pairs reconstruction based on plate scanning technique is considered. The great informative potential of plate scanning method is mentioned. The approach of analysis of traffic data gained from plate scanning devices is presented. Dependence of approach performance on form of input data is investigated.

articleTitle: Multiprogram digital control for bilinear object
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In works [1-4] the multiprogram stabilization problem (MPS problem) is considered for various classes of continuous control systems. Such systems are described by ordinary differential equations. In the article [5] for the first time this problem has been solved for a linear model of a digital object, i.e. for the linear difference system. Here we consider the bilinear control systems. This is broader class that allows simulating processes in various applications [6-9]. So it is important to extend multiprogram approach to the class of bilinear discrete control systems.

articleTitle: Analyzing simply supported plates using maple system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: An analytical solution of a boundary problem for system of differential equations in displacements, describing a strain of the rectangular plate supported by ribs of rigidity is received. The solution is presented in the form of series with combination of regular and special singular functions which converge fast, and lead to simple computing algorithm.

articleTitle: Software-defined radio in MATLAB Simulink with RTL-SDR hardware
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: USB TV receivers based on Realtek RTL2832U demodulator can serve as a cheap software-defined radio platform (RTL-SDR) with broad frequency range. Starting with Release 2013b, MATLAB/Simulink contains support package that provides interface to these devices. The paper describes RTL-SDR capabilities and possible applications implemented in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Application of position optimization method for control of information system of ground-space monitoring
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In this report models of control of information<;br/>system of unmanned spacecrafts and ground technical equipment providing<;br/>consumers of navigational information are considered.<;br/>Constructive methods of the optimal control theory are used in <;br/>the developed algorithm modification for this models combination. <;br/>It allow to control of operations of information system <;br/>under limited external actions by taking into account<;br/>the processing information about the system condition.

articleTitle: A numerical-analytical decomposition method in analyses of complex structures
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A new approach on a base of a method of numerical-analytical decomposition to analyzing elastic structures with cracks is proposed. A decomposition of the structure into parts for which exists numerical-analytical solutions lies in its foundation. A linear system for determining unknowns in general solutions is constructed satisfying joining conditions of the decomposition parts and boundary conditions. Realization of this approach is implemented using analytical system Maple.

articleTitle: Fuzzy and possibilistic segmentation of earth surface images by means of intelligent information technologies
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Earth surface images' segmentation problem by means of intelligent information technologies is considered. The application expediency of genetic algorithms for suboptimum segmentation results' receiving on the base of fuzzy and possibilistic clustering algorithms is shown. It is offered to use artificial neural networks for fuzzy and possibilistic segmentation results' specification.

articleTitle: Numerical-analytical computer modeling of a clamped isotropic thick plate
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A general solution for an elastic isotropic parallelepiped on a base of a superposition method is build. Three solutions used in it are received by the method of initial functions. Results of analyzing a clamped thick plate are presented. Numerical stability of the algorithm is discussed. Realization of this approach is made with analytical system Maple.

articleTitle: Computer modeling of trajectories in spatially non-uniform gravitational fields
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: On the basis of Newton's equations the problem of many physical bodies is considered. In particular, body movement in the non-uniform gravitational fields formed by group of attracting bodies is studied. Various options both a stationary arrangement of attracting bodies, and their movement are calculated. The corresponding three-dimensional trajectories of a studied body are constructed.

articleTitle: Time series forecasting models on the base of modified clonal selection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Forecasting models on the base of modified clonal selection algorithm, providing the forecast accuracy increase by means of analytical dependences' formation using antibodies, describing known values of time series are offered. Procedure antibodies' correct coding on the base of binary trees is developed. Models' program realization is executed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Multiple segmentation of the image series
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract:
The combined segmentation method of the same objects in a series of images is proposed.
This method is based on the propagation a single image segmentation results for all images in the series.
Images in the series transformed to the base image and segmented using previously obtained masks.

articleTitle: Computation parameters of cargo reservoir fill-up process on CNG-vessels in MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Filling and emptying processes of cargo reservoirs by natural gas on CNG-vessels mathematical model containing the equations of mass and energy conservation and thermal equation of state is developed. Gas-dynamics characteristics of stepwise tank fill-up process by real gas close on structure to Nord Stream mixture are performed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Mathematical software development for multispectral computer vision system in MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The research and algorithm development process in MATLAB for the multispectral computer vision system is described. There are a lot of ready-made tools for that in MATLAB. These tools save the development time. Then the well-tested computer vision algorithms are translated from MATLAB to C/C++ language for the further implementation.

articleTitle: The neural network of linear approximation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In this paper we consider a three-layer neural network, carrying out a polygonal approximation of the training set of data. In the process of supervised learning, neural network divides the input training set of data into n-dimensional simplex. We construct a hyperplane approximating output training signals for each simplex. This paper presents algorithm of learning a neural network. Neural network can be used to solve problems of prediction, recognition and classification of images.

articleTitle: The sparse approximation with combined dictionary of the acoustic signals
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In 2011 acoustic researches laboratory first proposed the sparse approximation method for detailed inner structure analysis of the geoacoustic emission signals measured continuously in Kamchatka. This paper considers the use of combined dictionaries for signal sparse approximation. The improved matching pursuit algorithm of refinement in the parameter space is proposed.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of two-step finite-difference schemes for the system of kinetic equations
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The modified two-step lattice Boltzmann scheme with central differences for the system of kinetic equations is investigated. The schemes with first-order and second-order upwind differences are proposed. Stability of these schemes is investigated using von Neumann method. The problem of stability investigation of unperturbed solution of the constructed schemes is reduced to the problem of stability analysis of the zero solution of system of difference equations with a square matrix. The spatially homogeneous stationary flows in unbounded domain are considered. Values of areas of stability domains for presented schemes are obtained. It is shown that the usage of special approximations of the convective terms in kinetic equations allows to obtain the greatest values of the areas of stability domains in parameter space.

articleTitle: Simulation of the dynamic loads and calculation of plane lock bypass galleries
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The deformation of flat water seal culvert of bypass galleries is investigated. The stress-strain state of the water seal is simulated by the problem of bending plate supported cross-bracing system. Mathematical model of loads on the locks is based on the study of nonlinear Lavrentiev problem of separated flows of an ideal fluid.

articleTitle: Control theory application to spacecraft scheduling problem
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: We present a new dynamic model for spacecrafts optimal scheduling. The approach is based on a dynamic decomposition of the problem and its solution with the help of maximum principle blended with combinatorial optimization.

articleTitle: Modelling of emission processes in Matlab
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The Matlab PDE Toolbox and Comsol Multiphysics coupling with Matlab via LiveLink are used in mathematical and computer modeling of field electron emission from emitter-arrays, as well as from single tip field electron emitter. Physical and mathematical models, computational methods and algorithms of stand alone Matlab application with graphical user interface are presented. The simulation results by the example of two different diode structures are also presented. Two generic cone-shape and cylindrical wedge-shape non-gated emitter-array diodes are considered. The effects of the variations in device geometrical structure and parameters on its potential distribution, electric field, and emission current are discussed. The current variation rate with respect to the tip-collector distance is calculated.

articleTitle: On analytical investigation and computer modeling of spacecraft nonlinear resonance oscillations
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Oscillatory attitude motion of a gravity-oriented spacecraft is considered. A special notation for differential equations of perturbed librational motion of the spacecraft is derived. The derived equations are convenient for the analysis of nonlinear resonance oscillations with the use of asymptotic methods and allow to obtain some new results.

articleTitle: Wavelet-based detection method for physiological pressure signal components
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: We describe a novel wavelet-based method to detect the time location of pressure signal components. The method is based on the continuous wavelet transform using the Haar wavelet. This method, in combination with others, can be used in algorithms such as beat detection algorithm for pressure signals and detection algorithm for pressure signal components.

articleTitle: Computer model for research of decoders for error-correction codes
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: It's described computer model for research of decoders for error-correction codes (turbo, low-density parity-check, self-orthogonal, short convolutional and others codes). The model allows evaluate bit and block error rate versus signal to noise ratio performance of decoders and estimate decoding rate. Simulation results are presented in convenient to analysis form.

articleTitle: Double smoothing in time series formalization
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Relevant questions of social-economy systems total product non-trivial dynamics modeling are discussed. We give the description of the illustrative example and its analysis typical procedures, and perform the concept of double smoothing and its application to organizational systems time series approximation.

articleTitle: Research of high-voltage cable installation's operating modes by means of program comsol with matlab
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Application of modern program complex COMSOL Multiphysics for calculation of the differential equations of an electromagnetic field and thermal conductivity in section of cable lines together with circuit calculation is considered in the report. Besides, it is shown that use of program COMSOL with MATLAB allows to expand possibilities of research of cable installation's operating modes by use of field models as computing algorithm in the editor of M-files.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling the radiative-convective-conductive heat transfer
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of a complex heat exchange in three-dimensional domain with reflecting boundaries is considered. An iterative algorithm based on the use of Finite Element Method is proposed. Software implementation of the algorithm is carried out in the package FreeFem++.

articleTitle: Effective false positive reduction in multilevel face detection system using convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract:
In this paper, the robust method for reduction of ‘false positive’ in
multilevel face detection system is proposed. The method is based on
convolutional neural network and trained on results from cascades of
boosted classifiers. Moreover, we evaluate the effect of modern
approaches like Dropout and DropConnect on network learning.

articleTitle: Parametric down conversion frequency-angle spectrum modeling
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In order to create and to investigate new nonclassical light sources it's necessary to build the relevant experimental scheme. Experimental setup design requires mathematical and computational premodeling. We perform the result of parametric down conversion angle-frequency spectrum modeling in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Construction of sonar images based on the received signal side-scan sonar
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In paper we consider the problem of constructing sonar images in a fluctuating ocean. The inverse problem of determine seabed scattering coefficient was researched within a single approximation of radiative transfer theory. There were got an explicit solution of the problem, the results of numerical and theoretical analysis of influence volume scattering on the quality sonar images. In paper we presented experiments with real data from side-scan sonar.

articleTitle: Studying informational sensitivity of computer algorithm solving TSP
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to obtain an estimate of the statistical measures of informational sensitivity for Concorde algorithm and the establishment of mean values and confidence intervals of the complexity for different sizes of input data. The result is that the algorithm and its implementation are highly sensitive to the input data.

articleTitle: Numerical aspects of one migration model
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: We propose a mathematical model of migration processes described by nonlinear non-autonomous system with discontinuous second member. We are especially interested in the system behavior near the break surface. The analysis shows that there exist sliding modes.<;br/>The model describes controlled migration policy. Setting of quotas in the recipient country is the most important kind of migration regulation and we use it as a control action in our model.

articleTitle: Modeling of ferroresonance phenomena in software products Simulink
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The report presents an algorithm combining field calculations of voltage transformers performed in the software package COMSOL Multiphysics, with chain calculations implemented by using the MATLAB. Comparison of software products Simulink, EMTP-RV and COMSOL Multiphysics performed by modeling and calculation capabilities ferroresonance phenomena that occur in instrument transformers.

articleTitle: A method of initial functions in analyzing a stress and strain state of an elastic layer
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A 3D problem of loading a linearly elastic layer using a method of initial functions is solved. Its realization is made in Maple system. A comparison with the FEM solution is presented.

articleTitle: A group of invariant transformations in the stability problem via Lyapunov's first method
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A group of invariant transformations the same as Lyapunov transformations is described. They don't change properties of correctness of differential equation systems and their characteristic numbers. It is shown that the Lyapunov transformations are a part of this group. Examples of invariant transformations different from the Lyapunov transformations are given.

articleTitle: The method of research into the nonlinear dynamical systems' space of parameters
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The suggested research method into nonlinear multidimensional dynamical systems (including those under the periodical external action) aims at the defining of the space parameters' bifurcation structure. Fundamentally this approach is based on the method of decomposition of these systems' space parameters, which allows investigating the dynamical behavior of the initial multidimensional system, composed of the nonlinear sub-systems. The use of this method is most effective in combination with other methods, for example - method of computational experiment, computer modeling etc.

articleTitle: Experiment control and data aquisition in electro-optical research
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Recent advances in nanotechnology demand automation of experimental measurements in such fields as nanoparticle size and electrical properties measurements. Such experiments require precision of automated optical measurements and electric field generation and stability. A flexible automated experimental setup that serves these purposes is presented in this report.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of biological liquids
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Biological liquids are contained in all biological tissues. Their mane function is the transfer of certain substances or particles. The mathematical models of the biological liquids with complex inner structure are proposed in the presented paper. Their peculiarities were taken into account through the non-Newtonian liquid model and specific kind of the liquid-structure interaction.

articleTitle: On the stability of equilibrium positions for certain classes of nonlinear hybrid mechanical systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Certain classes of nonlinear mechanical systems with switched force fields are studied. By the use of the Lyapunov direct method, sufficient conditions of asymptotic stability of equilibrium positions for considered systems are obtained. The results of a computer simulation in MATLAB are presented to illustrate the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Solution of the electrical equipment technical state assessment problem using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Today Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) is one of the main problems for grid companies in Russia. After the collapse of the USSR electrical substation are owned by energy companies. In the USSR equipment maintenance was carried out using the planned preventive maintenance system but it is economically inefficient in the current market conditions. Therefore today to solve the equipment technical state assessment task is necessary to use a new tool that allows operating the equipment according to his actual state. Such tools are diagnostic methods.

articleTitle: Performance testing of an approximate model predictive control algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: An approximate version of model predictive control proposed previously by the author is simulated using MATLAB. The experiments show how the algorithm's performance depends on its precision. Finally, the study gives insight into the effective implementation of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic scheduling robustness with the help of attainable sets
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The applicability of attainable sets (AS) to dynamic scheduling robustness analysis is provided. The robustness analysis of investigated operational system can be extended beyond existing approaches regarding multi-criteria and dynamic formulations.

articleTitle: Design and simulation research of anti-rolling tanks system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: This paper introduced an anti-rolling tank system of ship based on VC++. Build four degrees of freedom “Ship-Tank” mathematical model in an innovative way, and then research roll control strategy of ship under conditions of environmental interference. Simulation results show that, the system can achieve the desired effect of anti-rolling.

articleTitle: On the construction of a stabilizing control in input-output model
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: On the basis of the static Leontief input-output model the dynamic system is constructed. As a result the system of linear control differential equations is obtained. The components of the control vector in this system are the amount of taxes and subsidies for the respective industries. An algorithm for construction of a stabilizing control in the form of feedback on deviation is suggested. In conclusion, the results of computer calculations of the control vector based on a reduced input-output model are presented.

articleTitle: On a certain model of nonlinear multicomponent diffusion in solids
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In glasses and crystals the deviation of self-diffusion process for single component from the Arrhenius law is often observed. Various experimental results show that the diffusion coefficient can depends not only on the concentration of this single component, but also on concentration of other components. The article presents the mathematical model describing one possible mechanism of occurrence of such dependence. The iterative procedure for solving closed system of equations model of nonlinear multicomponent diffusion is constructed.

articleTitle: Terahertz emitter based on single-walled nanotube filled with fullerenes C60
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Model of terahertz emitter is based on carbon nanotubes filled with fullerenes by the molecular-mechanical method. Creating of the conditions for which there was observed a terahertz range of was carried out. It is shown that the emitter has a nanometer size.

articleTitle: Mathematical data processing of hepatobiliary scintigraphy with a motion correction
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Software implementation of a radionuclide studies data processing for the hepatobiliary system with a movement correction is proposed. A dynamic hepatobiliary scintigraphy is carried out by using a gamma camera or a SPECT. This approach allow us to determine the anatomical changes and the functional state of a liver and a gallbladder.

articleTitle: Implementation of electric arc model in Simulink/SimPowerSystems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of dynamical systems with variable degrees of freedom implementation in Simulink is considered. On the basis of a numerical model of a nonstationary electric arc describing the blowing dynamics and implemented in the C language Simulink/SimPowerSystems block was created. That block allows to represent the arc as generalized consumer which can be used to study the transient process at arc short circuit in high-voltage power grids.

articleTitle: Fractal dimensionality of the cross rates
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In article the behaviors of fractal dimensionality of time series and fractal dimensionality of the cross rations of two time series is considered. The fractal dimensionality for time series is determined by a Hurst index. Time series of a rate euro in relation to ruble and to dollar is considered.

articleTitle: Robust stability analysis of time-delay systems in MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In the paper, we present a constructive procedure for stability analysis of linear time-invariant differential systems with delay that is implemented in MATLAB. The algorithm is based on the Lyapunov - Krasovskii and the Razumikhin approaches, and allows estimating the critical parameters and the robustness bounds of the system.

articleTitle: Dynamical chaos in four dimensional phase space: Introduction to classification
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The report contains investigation of the system of equations describing the evolution of a dynamical system in four-dimensional phase space.

articleTitle: Analytical technique in the boundary element method for 3D problems of electron optics
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The analytical technique was developed for 3D boundary problems described by Poisson's equation. It includes the analytical integration over triangle elements represent the boundary surfaces, and over hexahedral space elements represent the space charge distribution with linear approximation for surface [1] and space source distributions [2]. Analytical integration removes the kernel singularities inherent to the original Green's function which corresponds to the integral representation for the single-layer potential. Special notice was attended to the analysis of the edge singularity problem for the field gradients. The complete set of equations for self-consistent problems of electron optics includes the field equation, the motion equation for relativistic particle in electromagnetic field, and the continuity equation for space charge and current density. This non linear problem was solving by iteration procedure with charge and current relaxation. The accuracy of numerical solution was demonstrated as for the test problems as for the realistic computer design of electron gun for 75MW X-band sheet-beam klystron by comparison with experimental data obtained at SLAC [3].

articleTitle: Simulation approach to the problem of organizational decision making within companies
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Simulation approach to the problem of promoting organizational decisions within a company is presented. The company is represented as a directed graph. Each subset of vertices includes one level of executives. A simulation model is implemented in Matlab environment. It allows one to analyze different scenarios of employees' reaction.

articleTitle: Sector-based SVG image contour analysis algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The image contour is represented as a sequence of sectors, where a sector is a figure formed with two contour points connected with the contour center and an angle between them. The sectors sequence comparison allows analyzing of image contours and defining similar contours without multiple calculations.

articleTitle: Multichannel WOLA algorithm in hydroacoustic monitoring tasks and its computer simulation in MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The paper presents a multichannel weighted overlap-add (WOLA) algorithm applied to sub-band signal processing in hydroacoustic monitoring tasks. WOLA is illustrated as a multichannel filter bank implementation in terms of block-by-block signal analysis using vector discrete Fourier transform. Software implementation in MATLAB is discussed and the computation times are provided.

articleTitle: Mathematical modelling of biological mobility
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the mathematical modelling of conformational rearrangement in biomaterial and to the formation of biological mobility at the micro level. For this purpose the actin-myosin interaction in muscle sarcomere and α - β tubulin interaction in the cilium and flagellum inner structure were considered.

articleTitle: On computer algebra methods and numerical simulation in the problems of charged satellite attitude dynamics
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A satellite with parametric attitude control system is considered. The satellite interacts with geophysical fields by gravitational, magnetic and Lorentz torques. The control algorithms for the satellite's stabilization are proposed. The correct mathematical model that ensures the prescribed accuracy is constructed with the use of computer algebra methods.

articleTitle: Order-disorder transitions in the Ising model
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The approach considered, that allows research a processes of order-disorder transition in various systems (with any distribution of the exchange integrals signs) in the Ising model. A new order parameters, that can give description of a phase transitions, is found. These parameters are defined as the mean value of percolation cluster size. Percolation cluster includes spins with given energy. The transition from absolute disorder into correlated phase could be studied with using of percolation theory methods. Transitions paramagnetic-superparamagnetic, paramagnetic-spin glass and paramagnetic-clustered antiferromagnetic are considered.

articleTitle: Characteristics of computational algorithms for calculating secondary-electron avalanche statistical parameters in heterogeneous microchannels
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A description of algorithms of direct calculation and investigation of multiplicative random process parameters is provided, taking into account the influence of nonlinear and nonhomogeneous medium in the form of a nonstationary charge in microchannel walls. Conception of such algorithms is based on the combination the Monte-Carlo method and the approach similar to the classical molecular dynamics. The algorithms are targeted to be used in a MATLAB environment.

articleTitle: Efficiency proof of Sirread algorithm
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The conference participants talks about an efficiency of SIRRead algorithm of interaction within dynamic systems. The DL-LiteR descriptive logic and complexity for the most popular reasoning aims of SOA-systems is shown. Results of testing showed that performance of SIR algorithm demands rather small amount of processor time.

articleTitle: Cluster space of time series: generalized characteristics and symbolic dynamics
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In the article, the authors propose coordinates of the clustering space for time series. The time series are obtained using the symbolic dynamics. The coordinates are the Kolmogorov complexity of time series and the measure of diversity of symbols.

articleTitle: Wavelet analysis of mechanical heart valve sounds with paravalvular leakage
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Discrete wavelet transform has been proposed for the diagnosis of paravalvular leakage(PVL) occurs after Mechanical Heart Valve(MHV) replacement. Mechanical heart sounds of 2 patients with PVL and 5 volunteers with normal MHV was recorded and analyzed with different wavelets. As a result, it is statically shown that Daubechies 2 wavelet function is suitable for diagnosis of PVL.

articleTitle: Using syntactic parsing for geographical names extraction on the example of newspaper articles
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: We consider the problem of geographical names extraction in arbitrary text. We describe a method of extracting geographical names using syntactic information obtained by PROMT syntactic parser. The method performance is evaluated on a newspaper text corpus.

articleTitle: Robust chaos generation on the basis of symmetry violations in attractors
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Robust chaos used in communication systems and communication. In the generated chaos in the case of a variation of parameters should not have periodicity windows. Besides, the dependence of older Lyapunov exponent is a function smoothly in wide range. A method of generating structural sustainable models based on the properties of weak violations of symmetries in the areas strange attractors.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of the cornea-scleral shell as applied to pressure-volume relationship in the human eye
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Relationship between intraocular pressure (IOP) and the intraocular volume (IOV) was obtained for three mechanical models with following problem statements: 1) the eyeball shell is assumed to be ellipsoidal transversal isotropic shell; 2) the corneoscleral shell of the eye is modeled as a conjugated shell consisting of two segments (sclera and cornea); 3) in the third model the coupled fluid-structure interactions in the eye are taken into account.

articleTitle: Dynamic publish/subscribe systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A dynamic publish/subscribe system must deal with new subscriptions and cancellation of existing subscriptions; for brevity it is assumed that the broker topology is static. It is easy to see that a routing configuration might not ensure the delivery of all notifications that are matched by a new subscription.

articleTitle: Solving problems of electrophysics in the MATLAB system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The authors consider problems of interaction of high energy particles with electromagnetic fields. Solution of many problems in accelerator technology are formulated in a matrix form, and therefore the use of MATLAB is the most effective. Range of such tasks is quite wide - from particle dynamics in individual elements of accelerator technology to the design of multi-elements transportation channels, where optimal parameters are determined by using extreme methods of searching.

articleTitle: Virtual laboratories in cloud infrastructure of educational institutions
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: MATLAB much used for the organization of computer laboratories in the cloud. The main components of the architecture are: use of SaaS- portal; autonomous system of automatic framework and control; hybrid cloud IaaS. We will consider scientific and educational resources of the educational institution in order to ensure definiteness of the research. Moscow Technological Institute is the largest Russian University, providing distance learning programs and possessing a powerful structure.

articleTitle: Computer recognition of the electronic circuit drawing in hard copy
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The computer program was created to simplify the time-consuming process of translating the hard copy drawing of electronic circuit into special code description. The input of the program is an image file with scan of electronic circuit plan, the output is a file in BDF format.

articleTitle: On the finite-element-based lattice boltzmann scheme for the computations of viscous flows on unstructured meshes
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A lattice Boltzmann scheme for computing on unstructured meshes is proposed. The scheme is based on the finite element method with Galerkin approximation. A program realization of the scheme is implemented with the use of the freefem++ v. 3.20 package. The possibility of the scheme application to practical problems is demonstrated by solving two test problems of computational fluid dynamics. The possibility of the use of equilibrium boundary conditions for the distribution functions is discussed for Reynolds number values less than 100.

articleTitle: Computer technologies based on optimization approach in control theory
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Report is devoted to basic conceptions of computer technologies and systems application in the wide area of control systems and processes investigation and design. A special attention is focused on the ideology of optimization approach connected with the problems of control systems modeling, analysis, and synthesis. Some questions of digital control laws real-time implementation are discussed. Computational algorithms are proposed for optimization problems with no formalized performance indices. The main positions are illustrated by correspondent numerical examples.

articleTitle: On one boundary problem for nonlinear stationary controlled system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A control object described by a nonlinear stationary system of ordinary differential equations with previously unknown disturbances is considered. The one method of construction of control function is developed. The efficiency is illustrated by numerical modeling of overhead crane trolley motion.

articleTitle: Simulation of electron motion in electric and magnetic fields by java programming
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Java programming with GUI has been developed to simulate a electron motion in electric and magnetic fields using a usual personal computer. The calculation begins by clicking the start button and the locus of electron can be displayed within several seconds. By changing the values in the text fields, the new motion can be immediately represented.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of inrush current in single-phase transformer using MATLAB's simscape environment
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Inrush current in the single-phase transformer is studied using model with detailed transformer magnetic circuit representation. Core saturation and hysteresis are taken into account by means of the Jiles-Atherton hysteresis model. The simulation is carried out in Matlab's Simscape environment using both library and user defined components.

articleTitle: Computer technology for short-term prediction of sea level anomalies spatial distribution in the arctic
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Computer technology for sea level anomalies prediction is developed for gridded regularly obtained satellite measured data as input. It is based on multivariate time series analysis, clusterization techniques and linear algebra numerical methods. It is certain to be interesting in oceanology, fishery, gas-and-oil producing industry in the Arctic region.

articleTitle: Calculation of the stressed state and the destruction of a thick-walled non-uniformly heated pipe which is exposed to high-temperature hydrogen corrosion means MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Long-term strength, creep and thermal field distribution in terms of construction unit in a high-temperature hydrogen corrosion calculated using the package Matlab. Long-term strength, creep and thermal field distribution in terms of construction unit in a high-temperature hydrogen corrosion calculated using the package Matlab.

articleTitle: The analyses of 2-D EM cloaking problem
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In this paper consider the cloaking shell scattering.<;br/>To avoid extreme values, introduce a small perturbation in the shell, perturbation tends to zero in order to study scattering problem. Sensitivity analysis of the shell directly determines the possibility of its application. Numerical algorithm for finding the scattered field is developed.

articleTitle: Self-tuning PID control based on LSSVM for ship steering system
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Self-tuning PID control based on Least Square Support Vector Machines (LSSVM) is applied for the control of ship steering. With the ship models which is built by LSSVM online, the PID controller parameters are able to be self-tuned at the same time and the simulation results with Matlab is presented.

articleTitle: Construction of the laws of distribution of lightning electromagnetic field parameters and modeling them in MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The article describes a method for simulating lightning electromagnetic field parameters (the electric and magnetic components) as random variables. Built their distribution laws taking into account various factors, such as type of lightning, its amperage, intensity of storm activity in different climatic regions, the distance to the lightning discharge. Implementation demonstrated in MATLAB. Formulated the direction of future research in this area.

articleTitle: Development decoding algorithm based on multithreshold decoder
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Now there is a set of various error corection methods. Among them it is possible to allocate the multithreshold decoder. In the report the algorithm of reduction of a level of errors because of of multithreshold decoder is considered. For check of an overall performance of algorithm the simulation modeling was conducted. The result on an output of the developed algorithm, for want of smaller ratio Eb/N0 begins to coincide a solution of the optimum decoder.

articleTitle: A conducting body in a varying magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A numerical method for computing the vector potential and gradient of scalar potential inside a conducting body in an external magnetic field varying harmonically with time is proposed. The method is illustrated by numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Algorithmic implementation of neural network errors analyzer in the local network
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: To perform accurate errors diagnostic in the local network, the administrator must accomplish many routine operations. To optimize operations and the cost in time, an alternative solution using neural network analyzer is presented in this article.

articleTitle: Computer realization of the hybrid algorithm of search of an extremum
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In present article the hybrid algorithm of search of an extremum based on the genetic algorithm and statistical evaluation of the gradient is described. The algorithm was implemented in the MATLAB environment, numerical experiments which confirmed operability of the algorithm were conducted.

articleTitle: An algorithm of deformation of a flat image
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In this paper we concern the problem of image (pictures, schemes) deformation. An image is applied to elastic film, surrounded by contour L1. The deformation is achieved by stretch the film to match the contour L1 with the specified contour L2. The results of machine experiments are shown.

articleTitle: Control voltage converters using simulink
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The report presents a method of controlling the rectifier-inverter device using a real-time controller dSpace. The control algorithm is developed in Simulink. Rectifier-inverter device allow combining of AC and DC systems, and are used for construction of high-voltage direct current (HVDC) systems and control DC motor.

articleTitle: Implementation of coaxial cable with frequency-dependent transmission-line parameters in Simulink/SimPowerSystems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A system comprising a coaxial cable and a generalized consumer is considered. Based on modified telegraph equations in frequency domain, the expression for equivalent conductivity of the system with frequency dependence is investigated. For mentioned frequency dependence Padé approximant for arbitrary range of frequencies is established which is employed to create block in Simulink/SimPowerSystems.

articleTitle: 3D MHD simulation of wire-array Z-pinch implosion under the action of high current pulse
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The 3D radiative-magnetohydrodynamic code MARPLE (KIAM RAS) was applied to simulations of wire-array Z-pinch experiments on ANGARA-5-1 pulsed power facility (TRINITI, Russia). Different configurations of wire arrays accelerated by the current up to 3.5 MA (pulse rise time 100 ns) were investigated as soft X-ray sources.

articleTitle: Simulation of ignition of cells of plasma display panel
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The chart design of ignition of cells of plasma display panel (PDP) is created out on the basis of the diagrams of the states and transitions in the system MatLAB - Simulink - Stateflow. She allows to estimate failure properties of cells influencing on each other, provides clear description of behavior of totality of the set alight cells, a simple change of project, a obvious presentation processes of ignition of cells, consequently, to use her for engineering researches.

articleTitle: Neural networks as nonlinear compensator models for digital communication systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: An important element of digital communication systems is a power amplifier (PA). PA is the source of nonlinear distortions at its high energy performance. PA nonlinear characteristics produce the expansion of signal spectrums that leads to interchannel interferences. One of effective ways of nonlinear distortion cancellation is nonlinear compensator synthesis. There are two types of compensator models, namely polynomials and neural networks. The functional link artificial neural network (FLANN), polynomial perceptron network (PPN) and radially pruned Volterra model are supposed as compensator models. These models and compared according to provided accuracy and computational complexity.

articleTitle: Object recognition and distance evaluation using single camera
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The template images of object and camera motion parameters are used as input data. The proposed approach is based on interest points detection and tracking through the sequence of images. The practical significance is demonstrated using Matlab examples and real-time experiments with a mobile robot.

articleTitle: The stability analysis of differential-difference equations with linearly increasing time delay using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The stability of linear differential-difference equations with linearly increasing time delay and time-dependent coefficients is studied in this work. The necessary and sufficient conditions of the asymptotic stability of such equations are given. The quadratic Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional is constructed. The sufficient conditions of the asymptotic stability, which derived using this functional, are presented. The results are illustrated using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Exact relaxation of multy point iterative methods
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Simple effective algorithm to calculate n-points iterative method exact relaxation is proposed and justified. The algorithm allows to circumvent the problem to find roots of polynomial with degree n > 2. The algorithm calculation price is easy estimated before iteration beginning. This lets a priory to specify expediency of the exact relaxation application.

articleTitle: Stabilization of complex heat transfer process
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The nonstationary model of radiative-convective-conductive heat transfer in a three-dimensional domain within the diffusion P1 approximation of radiative transfer is considered. The sufficient conditions of asymptotic stability of steady states are established. Some numerical experiments demonstrating the stabilization of complex heat transfer process are presented.

articleTitle: Methods of modeling of the test inputs for analysis the digital devices
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The automation of test software construction for the modern digital devices is required. For this purpose, the computer-aided designed system for the test software is design. The method of test program development for the control and diagnosis of digital devices.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of two-step finite-difference-based lattice Boltzmann scheme
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The modified two-step lattice Boltzmann scheme with central differences is proposed. It is shown that the scheme approximates the system of discrete Boltzmann equations with the second order on space variables, and with first order on time. Values of the Courant parameter for the scheme proposed and the values for the finite difference schemes presented in other studies are compared. The scheme shows the efficiency in solution of two test problems: the problem of cavity flow and the Couette problem.

articleTitle: Optimization of the multiconductor transmission line calculation
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: An efficient MATLAB method for the multiconductor transmission lines evaluation is presented. The proposed method is based on vectorization and parallel computing. The line's parameters are evaluated using vectorization. The phase-mode transformation is performed with parallel computing over the divided into several frequency ranges. A post-processing matrix normalization is applied.

articleTitle: On the stabilization of nonlinear potential systems using delayed feedback
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Mechanical systems with nonlinear potential forces and delayed feedback are studied. An approach for the constructing of nonlinear controllers providing the delay-independent asymptotic stability of the trivial equilibrium positions is proposed. The results of a computer simulation in MATLAB are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: The use of intelligent approaches to improve the quality of plasma coatings
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The main source of information was data collected in the study of the morphology of the surface after different modes of plasma spraying [1]. Microstructure analysis of data shows that coatings have strongly developed structure consisting of deformed melted particles with spherical shapes. Developing the algorithms and software for automatic detection of microparticles in digital images is of practical importance. With these tools available, we are able to create the automatic evaluation system for specific parameters of sprayed-on materials in the digital photos depicting their surfaces. We will be able to know the relative number of spheroidal particles and thereby forcast technological and operational properties of a coating.

articleTitle: The code “OPTICS-3” for 3D problems of electron optics
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The computer code “OPTICS-3” is based on use the Boundary Element Method (BEM) [1] for the field evaluation in complex-shape three-dimensional domains, and Principal Ray Method (PRM) [2] for the trajectory analysis. The PRM represents the wide beams with a few trajectories which are used as the curvilinear axes to make the 3-rd order aberration expansions in their vicinities. Those expansions need evaluation the high-order field derivatives up to fourth order. Thus, the combination of BEM and PRM gives the possibility to provide precision optic calculations, and substantially reduce the amount of computations comparatively with the numerical integration of Lorentz's motion equations. The necessity of taking into account the electric and magnetic fields excited by the beams creates non linear self-consistent problem, which is solved with iteration procedure. The perspective Grinberg's approach was not realized before for full three-dimensional electron optical systems, probably because of the complexity of its mathematical apparatus. Earlier successful realizations of aberration approach for two-dimensional problems of emission electron optics were presented in publications [3–4] for the code “OPTICS-2”, [5] for the code “ELIM-E” and [6] for the code “ELIM-D”. Here we present the first version of such computer code “OPTICS-3”, and some results of numerical simulations of electron gun for the 75 MW sheet-beam klystron with this code.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of SVM based direct AC/AC converter
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In this study, direct AC/AC converters controlled with space vector modulation (SVM) method are modelled in Matlab&Simulink. Direct AC/AC converters produce directly the three-phase load voltages which have variable frequency and variable amplitude, without rectifying the fixed three-phase input voltages. Simulation results are analyzed for output voltages with various frequency and amplitude.

articleTitle: Analysis of effects of prime mover speed and exciting capacitor value on output voltage of generator of self-excited squirrel cage induction generator
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In this study, impedance model of the induction generator was used. Steady state self-excitation voltages were calculated, taking into account the rotor parameter variations with the frequency. The minimum value of capacitance were obtained to initiate self-excitation by simulation results. The effects of speed and exciting capacitor on output voltage were analyzed.

articleTitle: Digital processing of radionuclide images
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: In this work the problem of determining velocity field for radionuclide image sequence is considered. This method is based on the assumptions of radiopharmaceutical density distribution gradient constancy. The problem is reduced to solving special linear system by block iterative method, the convergence of this method is investigated.

articleTitle: On the stationary points of coulomb's potential generated by point charges
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of finding the exact number and the coordinates of stationary points of the potential generated by a static configuration of point charges is investigated with the aid of symbolic algebraic algorithms. We also establish the bifurcation picture in the space of parameters of the configuration.

articleTitle: Simulation of processing and analyses of telemetry information about the state of complex dynamic objects
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The state of complex technical objects with dynamic behavior such as space objects is monitored using transmitted telemetry information in real time. To define and research various intelligent technologies oriented on the information processing and analyses a set of simulation techniques that are implemented as a specialized toolkit is proposed.

articleTitle: Magnetic phase transformations in the Ising model
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: We consider an approach, which allows researching a processes of order-disorder transition in various systems in the frame of Ising model. A new order parameters, which can give description of a phase transitions, are found. The common definition of these order parameters is the mean value of percolation cluster size.

articleTitle: Numerical modeling of thermal stresses in multi-pass welded joints with account of some technological features of welding
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: A numerical model is developed to evaluate residual stresses during multi-pass welding of the heterogeneous steels. The model based on the Lagrange's equation of plasticity and variational principle M. Biot. Plane stress and plane strain quasi-static problems are analyzed for estimate of residual thermal stresses during cooling of the weld.

articleTitle: An embedded method for integrating systems of structurally separated ordinary differential equations
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: An explicit nested method of integration of systems of structurally separated ordinary differential equations of first and second order is considered. Three-stage design schemes of the third order with automatic step selection for integration of systems of ordinary differential equations of first and second orderare built.

articleTitle: Calculation of phonon spectra for one-dimensional chains using computer algebra system reduce
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Calculation was done for phonon spectra of model one-dimensional chains using computer algebra system Reduce in the present work. The model chains consists from balls connected springs and contains two balls in elementary cell.

articleTitle: On the modification of lattice boltzmann method for the modelling of viscous incompressible flows
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Modification of the lattice Boltzmann method for computation of viscous incompressible fluid flows is proposed. The method is based on the splitting of differential operator in Navier - Stokes equation and on the idea of instantaneous Maxwellisation of distribution function. The method is based on explicit schemes and didn't have any problems with parallelization of computations. The stability of the method is demonstrated using von Neumann method in a wide range of input parameter values. The efficiency of the method proposed is demonstrated on the solution of the problem on the planar cavity flow.

articleTitle: Development of algorithms for plasma stabilization system synthesis in tokamaks in MATLAB-Simulink
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of plasma stabilization system design in tokamaks is considered. The development of algorithms for plasma stabilization in tokamaks in MATLAB-Simulink is discussed.

articleTitle: Computer modeling of scattering carbon atoms with graphene
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Collision processes of carbon atoms with a kinetic energy of 10 and 100 eV with graphene at certain points of this graphene have been studied by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Mathematical data processing of gated spect myocardial perfusion imaging with using wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of mathematical data processing of gated SPECT myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) is considered in the study. MPI is modern radionuclide cardiac study that allows evaluating a function of a myocardium. In the study we developed method to measure and visualize myocardial dyssynchrony using wavelet transforms from MPI data.

articleTitle: Intellectual material flows management in expert systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The software complex is implemented intelligent inventory management using fuzzy cognitive analysis. Have been defined and formalized the basic concepts of data and relations between them. The main attention is paid to the construction of fuzzy cognitive maps describing the selected subject area and situations inherent to it. Developed approaches to carrying out of static and dynamic modeling.

articleTitle: MATLAB - Based software for decision support systems
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Normal usage of MATLAB implies qualified programmer, while the graphical Simulink tool is applicable to restricted set of domains. Original software architecture is proposed to integrate MATLAB with extensive WEB-based GUI. The solution serves as a base for decision support systems for numerous application domains.

articleTitle: Optimal control of complex heat transfer
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of optimal boundary control of nonlinear elliptic systems describing conductive-convective-radiative heat transfer<;br/>in a three-dimensional domain is considered. The solvability of the control problem is proved, and the necessary optimality conditions of the first order are obtained. The results of numerical experiments are discussed.

articleTitle: Possibility investigation of experimental verification of general bell inequality violation for polarization scalar light based realization
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: We discuss the fundamental problems of nonclassical correlations and microscopic entanglement experimental observation possibility for multiphoton quantum light beams. Optical beams of multiphoton nonclassical light are of practical interest due to possibility of applications in quantum metrology and quantum informatics. Quantum macroscopic states of light are the significant information carrier in practical realization of quantum computing algorithms, quantum dense coding, quantum key distribution, quantum teleportation and other cases of quantum communications. And quantum macroscopic light beam can be used as high sensitive probe field in special type spectroscopy and in light sources and detectors etalonless calibration.

articleTitle: The algorithms of wordform generation and recognition
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: An universal method for wordform recognition and generation is proposed. It includes the model of word formation in natural languages and algorithms for wordform generation and recognition. In the wordformation model, abstracting from typical notions in the morphology of natural languages takes place.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of ionic wind in pulse mode
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Ionic wind is the air flow caused by corona discharge. Pulse mode of voltage supply is of interest in respect to increasing power efficiency, reducing size and mass of device, decreasing supplying voltage. Flow character is considered in dependence of pulse duration and time gap between pulses. Optimization parameters are introduced and discussed.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-immune PID controller for ship steering autopilot
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Based on the bionics theory of biological immune system, a P-type immune feedback controller is created to improve conventional PID controller performance. Combining with fuzzy PID control used in feedback control link, the controller parameters for ship can be adjusted by the rules of immune feedback principle and fuzzy logics.

articleTitle: Modeling of deformation of an elastic body slice
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The exterior slice contains slices of internal elements of the body which are deformed and moved during the deformation. By means of x-ray (ultrasound) new positions and sizes of the elements are found. We propose the algorithm of constructing the deformed image, which may be implemented as a MATLAB toolbox.

articleTitle: Physical modeling with simmechanics for two-linked robot
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: The problem of formation and approach of mathematical model and design control law for two-linked robot manipulator is considered. This type of robot can be provided in the form of an inverted T-shaped pendulum. The method of physical modeling in Simulink with using the library SimScape SimMechanics is suggested. Main features of this modeling type are considered. The dynamic properties of the obtained model and linear model of T-shaped pendulum are investigated and described. The speed control law for control object is designed.<;br/>

articleTitle: Equilibrium properties of the planar system of finite number dipoles in random positions
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: An analytical solution have been obtained for the energy of system of the high-anisotropic spherical magnetic dipoles. By the method of numerical simulation have been determined the density of states for the purpose of calculating the properties of system in thermodynamic equilibrium. It is planned to make hypothesis testing about the existence of an amorphous dipole ferromagnetism.

articleTitle: Amplitude death and broadband synchronization in the coupled delayed-feedback electronic oscillators
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Effects of interaction of two ring-loop electronic oscillators with time-delayed feedback are investigated. Nearly periodical zones of amplitude death and beating regimes separated by the “broadband synchronization” domains are revealed. Similar synchronization picture is observed in a system of two coupled klystron vacuum-tube oscillators.

articleTitle: Asymptotic behavior of nonlinear non-autonomous mechanical systems with two-component homogeneous potential forces
publicationTitle: 2014 International Conference on Computer Technologies in Physical and Engineering Applications (ICCTPEA)
abstract: Nonlinear non-autonomous mechanical systems with two-component homogeneous potential forces are considered. Based on method of Lyapunov functions there were proved several theorems that provide asymptotic stability and ultimate boundedness of solutions of system under variety of conditions. MATLAB computing environment was used to numerically estimate some of the obtained results.
